website.name: ClientFlow
website.title: ClientFlow – Client and team follow-up
website.description: Keep your prospects, team and daily consistency in one place. Activity rings, follow-up alerts and a summary for your sponsor.

Footer.description: ClientFlow helps you follow up with every contact, support your team and stay consistent every day.

Hero.title: Never let a contact go cold
Hero.description: ClientFlow organizes your prospects, team and daily activity. Close your rings, get follow-up alerts and share your progress in one tap.

Feature.title: All your follow-up in one place
Feature.description: Six areas designed to keep you consistent and never miss an opportunity.
Feature.prospectsDesc: Pipeline by stage and temperature, with next actions and stalled-contact alerts.
Feature.ringsDesc: Conversations, follow-ups and posts: close all three and build your streak.
Feature.teamDesc: Your downline with shadow nodes, progress checklist and volume per person.
Feature.socialDesc: Log what you post: business, product and lifestyle.
Feature.monthDesc: Weighted focus metrics with overall progress.
Feature.reportDesc: A ready-to-send summary for your sponsor on WhatsApp.

Testimonial.title: What people say
Testimonial.quoteOne: I finally stopped forgetting follow-ups. The stalled alert saved several sales.
Testimonial.quoteTwo: The rings make me want to close the day. My streak is at three weeks.
Testimonial.quoteThree: Putting together my sponsor report takes ten seconds.
Testimonial.quoteFour: The team tree with shadow nodes is exactly what I needed.
Testimonial.quoteFive: I use it from my phone all day and it works great.

Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.questionOne: Do I need an account to try it?
Faq.answerOne: You can sign in with the demo account, which comes with fictional data, or create your own.
Faq.answerTwo: An open contact with an overdue follow-up or no activity for more than 7 days.
Faq.answerThree: A team member you manage until they create their own account.
Faq.answerFour: In Cloud Firestore, isolated per user with security rules. In demo mode they are stored only in your browser.
Faq.answerFive: Yes, the interface adapts with a bottom navigation bar.

Cta.title: Start following up with every contact today
Cta.description: Create your account in a minute or try the demo with sample data.
